commands.review_summary:
The branch changes Android gateway endpoint parsing to strip percent-encoded IPv6 zone suffixes from parsed hosts and updates two parser tests to expect zone-free display URLs.

PR surface: Other +6. Total +6 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main accepts scoped IPv6 endpoint strings, stores the encoded scope in GatewayEndpointConfig.host, then builds a WebSocket URL string that OkHttp rejects for scoped host syntax. I did not run a live Android gateway connection.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] A maintainer needs to choose scoped IPv6 support versus explicit rejection, and the contributor needs real Android behavior proof before merge.

target.title: fix(android): normalize IPv6 zone IDs in gateway endpoint hosts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Gateway endpoint URLs with IPv6 interface zones — e.g. `ws://[fe80::1%25eth0]` — passed cleartext host validation but stored the host as `fe80::1%25eth0` (URL-encoded zone suffix).

`GatewayHostSecurity.isLocalCleartextGatewayHost()` strips the zone at `%` before validation, so link-local checks succeed. However, `GatewaySession.buildGatewayWebSocketUrl()` used the stored host verbatim, producing socket authorities like `[fe80::1%25eth0]:18789` that fail to connect.

Validation and connection therefore disagreed on the host shape.

## Why This Change Was Made

Normalize parsed gateway hosts via `normalizeGatewayConnectionHost()` in `parseGatewayEndpointResult()`:
- Strip IPv6 interface zone suffixes at the first `%` (same rule as cleartext host security checks)
- Store socket-ready bare literals (e.g. `fe80::1`) in `GatewayEndpointConfig.host`

Display URLs continue to bracket IPv6 literals without zone suffixes.

## User Impact

Manual or setup-code LAN gateway URLs that include IPv6 zone identifiers can connect successfully instead of failing after passing UI validation.

## Evidence

**Updated regression tests in `GatewayConfigResolverTest`:**
- `parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls`
- `parseGatewayEndpointAllowsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls`

Example:
```kotlin
parseGatewayEndpoint("ws://[fe80::1%25eth0]")
// host == "fe80::1", displayUrl == "http://[fe80::1]:18789"
```

**Proof command:**
```bash
cd apps/android
./gradlew :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest \
  --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.GatewayConfigResolverTest.parseGatewayEndpointAllowsLinkLocalIpv6ZoneCleartextWsUrls \
  --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.GatewayConfigResolverTest.parseGatewayEndpointAllowsSecureIpv6ZoneUrls
```

**Changed files:**
- `apps/android/app/src/main/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/GatewayConfigResolver.kt`
- `apps/android/app/src/test/java/ai/openclaw/app/ui/GatewayConfigResolverTest.kt`
